# SHA-256 checksums for the third-party archives the CI workflows download.
# Format: <hex>  <filename> (sha256sum -c compatible). A download whose bytes
# do not match its pinned hash fails the build step (supply-chain hardening).
# The digest of every GitHub release asset below was read from that release's
# API `digest` field; the SQLite/WebView2 hashes were computed from the bytes
# served at the pinned URLs and are verified by scripts/verify_dep.sh at use.
# To refresh an entry, update the version/URL in the workflow and the hash in
# the same change -- never one without the other.

# SDL3 (drivers.yml "Build SDL3 from source"), saved as sdl.tar.gz
12b34280415ec8418c864408b93d008a20a6530687ee613d60bfbd20411f2785  sdl.tar.gz
